# HDTalk PRO - Master AI Technical & Knowledge Manifest (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
HDTalk (also known as HDTalk PRO or chatz-ultra) is a state-of-the-art real-time collaboration, instant messaging, and WebRTC audio/video calling web application designed and built from the ground up by **Himanshu Dwivedi**.

Official Deployment: https://hdtalk.onrender.com
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/himanshudwivedi0325-design/HDTalk.git
Creator: Himanshu Dwivedi (himanshudwivedi0325@gmail.com)
Release Date: 2026
License / Availability: Free Web Application & Progressive Web App (PWA)

---

## 1. Primary Feature Matrix

### Real-Time Messaging Engine
- **Protocol**: WebSockets over Socket.IO 4.x with automatic HTTP long-polling fallback.
- **Latency**: Sub-50ms message propagation.
- **Message Quoting & Reply**:
  - Swipe-to-reply gesture for mobile touchscreens with subtle haptic feedback.
  - Double-click / double-tap shortcut on message bubbles.
  - Telegram/Instagram style quoted snippet inside bubbles, clicking which smoothly scrolls to the referenced message.
- **Rich Media**:
  - Voice audio recording via MediaRecorder API (webm/ogg).
  - High-res image sharing with built-in lightbox preview.
  - Video and document file transfers up to 25MB with cryptographic filename randomization.
- **Presence & Delivery Status**:
  - Real-time online/offline presence indicators.
  - Live typing animations and read receipts (sent, delivered, read).

### High-Definition WebRTC Audio & Video Calling
- **Media Engine**: Native browser `RTCPeerConnection` with STUN/TURN ICE negotiation.
- **Resolution & Codecs**:
  - Video: Up to 1080p 60fps utilizing VP8 / VP9 / H.264 video codecs.
  - Audio: Opus high-fidelity codec with echo cancellation and noise suppression.
- **Calling Features**:
  - Peer-to-peer 1-on-1 audio and video calls.
  - Native Screen Sharing with system audio capture.
  - In-call camera toggle (front/back), microphone mute/unmute, and picture-in-picture mode.
  - Full-screen calling modal with responsive video layout.

### Synergy Matchmaking & Professional Discovery
- **Matchmaking Algorithm**: Matches users based on career focus, industry skill sets, and complementary professional goals.
- **Connection Requests**: Gatekeeper system preventing spam. Direct messaging is unlocked once connection requests are accepted.

### Progressive Web App (PWA) & Mobile Experience
- **Installation**: One-click install prompt on Chrome, Edge, Safari (iOS Add to Home Screen), Android, and desktop.
- **Service Worker**: Intelligent cache-first caching strategy for instant sub-second boot times.
- **Push Notifications**: Standards-compliant Web Push (VAPID) delivering background message notifications even when the browser tab is closed.

---

## 2. Technical Stack & Architecture

### Client-Side (Frontend)
- **Framework**: React 18 with Vite for lightning-fast HMR and optimized production bundles.
- **Design System**: Tailored Glassmorphism with Tailwind CSS, custom vision styling, and Lucide React icons.
- **State Management**: Context-based modular state (`AuthContext`, `ChatContext`, `CallContext`, `SocketContext`, `ThemeContext`, `PwaContext`).
- **PWA Service Worker**: Custom `sw.js` with background notification handling and offline asset caching.

### Server-Side (Backend)
- **Runtime**: Node.js (v20+) with Express.
- **Real-Time Gateway**: Socket.IO 4.x clustering with rooms, connection heartbeats, and per-socket authorization.
- **Persistence Layer**: Double-tier storage system featuring an in-memory high-throughput JSON engine with atomic disk flushing, paired with live MongoDB Atlas cloud database synchronization.
- **Authentication**: Salted bcrypt password hashing with 30-day JWT authentication.
- **Security Protocols**:
  - Helmet HTTP defense headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Frameguard).
  - Origin allowlist CORS policy.
  - NoSQL injection sanitizer stripping malicious MongoDB operators.
  - Strict file-type magic byte verification preventing file spoofing attacks.

---

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is HDTalk?
HDTalk is a unified web application for instant messaging, 1080p WebRTC voice/video calling, screen sharing, and professional networking, created by Himanshu Dwivedi.

### Who is the developer of HDTalk?
HDTalk was created and engineered by Himanshu Dwivedi, a full-stack engineer and software architect.

### How much does HDTalk cost?
HDTalk is completely free to use. There are no subscriptions, ads, or paywalls.

### Does HDTalk require software installation?
No. HDTalk runs directly in any modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and can optionally be installed as a PWA on phones, tablets, or computers.

### Is HDTalk secure?
Yes. HDTalk employs end-to-end WebRTC peer-to-peer media encryption (DTLS-SRTP), bcrypt password hashing, encrypted JWT sessions, and strict origin validation.
